summary: Defines Opus, an audio codec for interactive speech and music. It handles uses such as voice over IP, videoconferencing, in-game chat, and live music, and scales from low-bitrate narrowband speech up to very high quality stereo music. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Opus is a clever way to squeeze sound into small packages for sending over the internet. It works for a quiet whisper or a whole band, and it adjusts to how much room there is.

questions: which codec to use for voip and music
